answer.value: Causal language model, 2.4T total parameters with 95B activated, 92 layers, hidden dimension 8192, hybrid layout 23 × (3 × (Gated DeltaNet → MoE) → 1 × (Gated Attention → MoE)). Gated Attention: 64 Q heads and 4 KV heads, head dimension 256. Gated DeltaNet: 128 V and 16 QK linear attention heads, head dimension 128. MoE: 512 experts, 10 routed + 1 shared activated, expert intermediate dimension 2048. MTP trained with multiple steps. Built on the architectural foundation of Qwen3.5. The card gives no explicit rationale for the design choices.
quotes: Number of Parameters: 2.4T in total and 95B activated
Hidden Layout: 23 × (3 × (Gated DeltaNet → MoE) → 1 × (Gated Attention → MoE))
Number of Attention Heads: 64 for Q and 4 for KV
Number of Linear Attention Heads: 128 for V and 16 for QK
Number of Activated Experts: 10 Routed + 1 Shared
